errors.evidence: The categories of risks are presented on the vertical axis. The horizontal axis represents the percentage values from 0% to 50%.

errors.text_span: Вертикалната ос е скалирана линейно от 0% до 50%, отбелязана на стъпки от 5%
errors.evidence: This is a description of the horizontal axis. The vertical axis lists the different categories of risks and is not a numerical scale.
The percentage for „Политически риск“ (Political risk) is 48.6%, not 45.6% as stated in the description.
The list of colors is incomplete; it omits the brown color used for the bar representing "Други рискове" (Other risks).
